subject: Small 3.1, OCR & Multimodal | Hi from [SENDER] @ Encord
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I lead a Frontier Labs team here at Encord - we're working closely with a few of your peers to help them iterate faster on foundation model training and evaluation-especially in multimodal and GenAI contexts.

I've been following Mistral's progress with Small 3.1, OCR, and your broader push into multimodal capabilities and would be keen to get your feedback on what we're building here-particularly around multimodal data labeling (text, video/image, docs, etc), dimensionality reduction for visualization, or RLHF-style pipelines using Likert-based human feedback.

Would you be open to a quick 20-min conversation in the next week or two? Wednesdays or Thursdays tend to be easiest on my side.
